 Governor Election Results
 As of Wednesday morning, Democrats took five new seats for a total of 29, giving them a majority for the first time in years. The wins could expand state-level resistance to the Trump administration.

County type designations are based on a New York Times analysis of data from the U.S. Census, the National Center for Health Statistics, and other research. County and township demographics, including median household income, race/ethnicity, age and educational attainment, are from the census. Age shares represent a percentage of the adult population, and college-educated shares represent a percentage of adults age 25 and older. High-income refers to a median household income of $100,000 and higher.
